secant-to-tangent.alt: The curve y = f(x) with a point at x = a and a second point at x = a + h. A dashed secant line joins them; the run h and the rise f(a + h) minus f(a) are marked. A solid tangent line touches the curve at x = a. The secant slope is the average rate on [a, a + h]; as h shrinks to 0 it approaches the tangent slope f prime of a.
